preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The length of S must be between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min((len(S) - len(suffix)) for suffix in [S[i:] for i in range(len(S))] if (suffix + S[:i])[::-1] == (suffix + S[:i]))
postconditions.description: The return value is the minimum number of characters to add at the front to make the string a palindrome, computed by finding the longest suffix of S that is already a palindrome and subtracting its length from the total length.
The return value must be a non-negative integer.
